modal.title: Owner report
modal.subtitle: The visit in plain English, for the owner to take home.
modal.noteFindings: Findings written in plain English — no codes or jargon.
modal.photosTag: Tag photos Before/After in Images to include them.
modal.buildFailed: Couldn't build the owner report. Retry in a moment.

section.title: Owner Report
section.customizeTitle: Change the report's layout, wording, language and sections
section.writeTitle: Draft the opening summary and home care advice from this chart — you review before printing
section.intro: A plain-English take-home version of this chart. The findings below are generated automatically as you chart; the text blocks are prefilled and editable, so you can put it together properly before printing. Tag photos as Before/After in the Images section to include them.
section.templateHint: Sets the layout, language, and default wording. Practice owners manage templates in Practice settings.
section.summaryHint: Prints under the header, before the findings.
section.noteLabel: A note from your veterinary team (optional)
section.noteHint: Printed as its own section — anything specific to this patient.
section.homecareHint: One tip per line — each prints as a bullet.
section.replaceMessage: The AI draft replaces the opening summary and home care advice you edited. You can undo right after.
section.drafted: Draft written — please read it over before printing.
section.draftEmpty: The AI didn’t return a draft. Please try again.
section.printTitle: What will print (generated from the chart)
section.noFindings: No per-tooth findings recorded yet — the report will say so (in a good way).

templates.title: Owner report templates
templates.readOnly: Only practice owners can edit. You can look through the templates and preview them.
templates.datesLong: Written out, in the report language
templates.languageHint: The language applies to everything the report writes for you — headings, findings, tooth names and default text. Text your team types prints as written.
templates.insertHelp: Click a placeholder to insert it into the field you’re editing (any text field below). Capitalize it — {Pet} — to capitalize the value.
templates.summaryEmpty: Leave empty to use the standard opening shown in grey.
templates.sectionsHint: Turn sections on or off, rename their headings, and set the print order. Sections with nothing to say for a visit (no extractions, no photos…) are skipped automatically.
templates.sectionTextPlaceholder: Text printed under the heading — e.g. pricing for your dental plans, or after-hours contact details.
templates.tipsPerChart: Each chart can still edit its own tips in the Owner Report section.
templates.closingPlaceholder: e.g. Thank you for trusting us with {pet}'s care!
templates.footerHint: Printed in small type at the bottom of every page.
templates.previewSubtitle: Sample visit. Real reports also include the mouth diagram and any before/after photos.
templates.discardConfirm: Discard your unsaved changes to the owner report templates?
templates.deleteConfirm: Delete the “{{name}}” template? Charts that use it switch to the default.
templates.previewFailed: Couldn't build the preview. Try again in a moment.
templates.loadFailed: Your saved templates didn’t load, so you’re seeing the built-in default. Saving is turned off so it can’t replace them — reload the page to try again.
